decision: MACRO DESIGN READY WITH MATERIAL IDENTIFICATION LIMITATIONS
as_of_rule: Date resolution at end of t0: reference_period_end, release_date, vintage_date, revision_date <= t0. Intraday use unsupported. Conservative proven upper bounds allowed; arbitrary fixed lags are not dates.
revision_rule: Newest complete eligible reference period, latest value version known by t0; first-release sensitivity requires revision_sequence=0 and complete initial-release evidence.
transformation_rule: Both operands selected under same t0 and revision policy. Exact lag-period end; missing returns unavailable. Preserve all source/date/hash lineage. No future interpolation.

scenario_governance.weights: Optional; defensible source/method, all-or-none across set, sum1. No fabricated weights. Historical replay descriptive and unweighted.
scenario_governance.paths: Monthly future period-end, complete1..H for each variable, consistent units; preserve source-native conversion rule. Historical replay retains original dates.
scenario_governance.official_label: Only actual cited official provider release; research downside is not regulatory

identification_strategy: A: prespecified multi-origination-vintage national-macro predictive competing-risk design with explicit constrained duration/cohort representation
vintage_choice_basis: Housing contraction, recovery, different rate regimes, pandemic cohort and post-low-rate originations; no performance-based selection
apc_caveat: Even multiple vintages do not identify unrestricted age+period+cohort; impose disclosed constraints and test overlap/conditioning. No causal macro coefficients.
future_acquisition_gate: Separate user authorization and terms/resource budget
Same source release layout/schema and immutable hashes
Small deterministic pilot per new vintage; no whole-history extraction
Initial macro/version release coverage incl pre2010 HPI established or explicitly excluded
No evaluation artifacts or consumed ledger reuse
future_modeling_gate: Multiple cohorts and age/calendar support matrix
Macro per-version dates and raw hashes certified
Feature registry/frequency/units harmonization and staleness diagnostics
New development and future-calendar plus facility-separated evaluation protocol sealed
Effective calendar sample size and calendar-block uncertainty
Future-state distribution and payoff dynamics for prospective CIF
Independent review of identification restrictions before fitting
task6_integration: New separately authorized competing-hazard study; no Task6 refit. Monthly joint hazards with loan state X(t), known macro M(t). Scenarios alone do not supply future loan states.
